item.title: Brainstorm
item.description:
Brainstorm is a command-line MIDI recorder from Div’s MIDI Utilities. It listens to incoming MIDI and automatically captures what you play, so musical ideas can be saved without starting a manual recording session.

For a practical workflow using Brainstorm with JACK and LinuxSampler, see How I Recorded The First Brainstorm.
